description: This file contains utility functions for the ERPNext setup module, including functions for retrieving hierarchical data, setting up test defaults, fetching exchange rates, and sending welcome emails.

methods.name: get_root_of
methods.description: Retrieves the root element of a hierarchical DocType with a tree structure.

methods.name: get_ancestors_of
methods.description: Retrieves ancestor elements of a hierarchical DocType.

methods.name: before_tests
methods.description: Prepares the environment for testing by setting up default data and clearing caches.

methods.name: get_exchange_rate
methods.description: Fetches the current exchange rate between two currencies, using cache and external API as fallback.

methods.name: enable_all_roles_and_domains
methods.description: Enables all roles and domains for testing purposes.

methods.name: set_defaults_for_tests
methods.description: Sets default values for certain settings to facilitate testing.

methods.name: insert_record
methods.description: Inserts multiple records into the database, ignoring duplicates.

methods.name: welcome_email
methods.description: Generates a welcome email title based on the default company.
